lines.text: Many learners say: Everyone are happy today.
Everyone is like one person. Use is.

data.why: Everyone is like one person. Use is.

native.tip: everyone 虽然指很多人，但语法上是单数，动词用 is。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Everyone are happy today.”？😅 everyone 在语法上是单数，动词要用 is：“Everyone is happy today.”。跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“is”。everyone 语法上是单数！免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Everyone is grammatically singular, so use is.
en.caption: Do you say “Everyone are happy today.”? 😅 Everyone is singular in grammar, so use is: “Everyone is happy today.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
